title: The red rose wins
html_source: This is a reference to the war of the roses, between the houses of Lancaster and York.

anchor.prefix:
face looked very black but he was not in a wax: he was laughing. Then Jack Lawton cracked his fingers and Father Arnall looked at his copybook and said:

 —Right. Bravo Lancaster!
anchor.suffix:
. Come on now, York! Forge ahead!

 Jack Lawton looked over from his side. The little silk badge with the red rose on it looked very rich because he had a blue sailor top on. Steph
